Subject: Staged API credentialing + CAIQ fragment upload for Oakridge onboarding

Hi Sophie / Vendr team,

Oakridge Health is ready to move into the portal onboarding window and they want us to automate the initial evidence push so their SecOps can start the SIG->CAIQ reconciliation. Two asks from our side: 

1) Can you provision a short-lived staged API credential (scoped to uploads only) so our ingestion runner can POST CAIQ fragments and Q&A attachments? We prefer HMAC keys (key id + secret) with a TTL of 72 hours.

2) We'll be sending a condensed CAIQ fragment mapping (attached) — it maps our SIG answers to CAIQ control IDs. Please confirm file naming expectations and whether you need the CSV variant (I attached an index).

Attachment stubs: sig-caiq-mapping-v0.3.xlsx, staged-api-key-template.txt, oakridge-evidence-index.csv

I copied Laura for evidence ownership and Priyom for the upload job. Proposed timeline: provision creds by EOD tomorrow (2028-04-12) so we can run a dry upload on Thursday.

Thanks — Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@vendr.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: onboarding@vendrsolutions.com, Oakridge SecOps <secops@oakridge-health.com>
Date: 2028-04-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staged API credentialing + CAIQ fragment upload for Oakridge onboarding

Hi Rishi,

Thanks — we can support a scoped HMAC pair for uploads. A few details so we provision correctly:

- Scope: /api/v1/uploads/ca iq-fragments and /api/v1/uploads/assets only.
- TTL: 72 hours is fine; we will issue a key_id/secret pair.
- Rate limit: 1200 calls/minute for the scoped key.
- File expectations: Accepts .csv and .xlsx; preferred filename convention: oakridge_caiq_fragment_<YYYYMMDD>_<part>.xlsx

We noticed the mapping references a custom control tag (RDW-SIG-01). Please include the CAIQ control ID column (we can help map but need the column).

Provisioning plan: we will create a temporary key in the Vendr portal and post the credential JSON to the secure link below. To confirm the SFTP manifest workflow you referenced, can you provide the intended manifest path? We can also accept direct API uploads if you want end-to-end automation.

Portal onboarding link: https://vendrportal.vendr.com/accounts/OakridgeHealth/onboarding/5678
SFTP staging (if needed): sftp://uploads.vendr.com/oakridge/stage/manifest.json

I'll create the key and share the key_id (secret delivered via our secure channel) once you confirm the manifest path.

Cheers,
Sophie Chen
Onboarding Lead — Vendr Solutions

Laura / Priyom — quick plan from my side:

- Laura: can you assemble the minimal evidence set we plan to push first? I suggest the SIG core answers (pdf export), the CAIQ fragment spreadsheet (attached), and the S3-hosted syslog sample referenced in the index. Put them in the oakridge-evidence bucket path and list filenames in the oakridge-evidence-index.csv (attached).
- Priyom: once Sophie confirms path/keys, we will run the ingestion runner against the scoped API. Use the staged-api-key-template.txt to model the request headers.

Operational constraints: keep the initial payload under 150MB and split fragments into 1..5 parts so Vendr can reconcile incremental uploads. We want one dry-run (no status push to Oakridge) and then a second run to mark items as "submitted" in the portal.

Questions for you both: who will own the CAIQ->SIG control mapping review? I can do an initial pass but would like Priyom to validate the column formatting.

If you both are OK, I'll confirm with Sophie that we want API-first (no SFTP).

-Rishi
